description: Retrieval service mediating Postgres core/agent and the Oxigraph graph for agents and the clinician/hospital UI; implements ADR-002 (Postgres-first writes, synchronous graph projection on success). FR1-FR11: write projector, read endpoints with inline evidence resolution, agent-input endpoints (referral context, cohort, scores-for-run) with computed CRT breach, and new-referral intake for the UI.
